title: Constructible preimages under arbitrary scheme morphisms
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. If $C\subseteq |Y|$ is a constructible subset [def-weil-constructible-subset], then its set-theoretic inverse image $f^{-1}(C)\subseteq |X|$ is constructible. No Noetherian, quasi-compactness or finite-type hypothesis on the schemes or morphism is imposed.

source.place: Tag 054I, lemma-inverse-image-constructible, constructible (not merely locally constructible) clause
